items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: all this other stuff... Roy Newman, Roy A, all this other stuff.

ctx.x: Is this the only sponsor you remember?

Those two, that XEPN thing, and then the Buck brand buckaroos twice a week. We used to get paid, it seems to me, three and a half per radio program by the station for those Buck brand buckaroos. We'd get seven dollars a week coming in from that. But in the Depression days, it helped out. But you see, being kind of, this gave us the status of a staff band in a way. And this was above the other groups, the Bill Boyd even, and all those others, Roy Newman, Roy A, all this other stuff. And gave us a little standard.…
Mm-hmm. For how many years did you work for the border stations in this capacity?
